TASK-168 fixtures are original synthetic TrueType fonts generated by
build_fallback_fonts.py with the already installed fontTools test tool. No
third-party font outlines are copied. The repository's license applies.

All three use 1000 units/em and ascent-minus-descent 1000. Primary uses
800/-200, CJK 750/-250, and Mark 900/-100, deliberately testing a shared primary
baseline instead of each fallback's own baseline. Primary maps M/A/e to a
rectangle at (100,0)-(500,600), advance 600. CJK maps 繁/體/中/𠮷/E to a rectangle
at (50,0)-(1150,700), advance 1200. Mark maps U+0301 to a rectangle at
(-450,650)-(-150,750), zero advance. Primary also maps E/B to its empty space
glyph: E must fall through to CJK's outline, B must get a missing-glyph box.
Missing glyph and space have no outline. Family names omit the filename hyphen
because a bare Fontconfig pattern interprets hyphens as size delimiters.

These distinct coverage sets verify real font cmap/outline selection,
shared baseline, two-cell CJK width, negative-bearing combining placement over
both narrow and wide bases, missing-glyph visibility, and scale/cache behavior.
They do not prove typography, ligature/complex shaping, color emoji, or desktop
font acceptance. Unit tests load the checked-in bytes and require neither
Fontconfig nor fontTools.
